title: Edmund and the Static
author: Noor Nakamura
blurb: Jude Underhill, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
